page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated 2.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The memory configuration provides 372.0 GB of RAM, equating to 7.75 GB per core. For local storage, the instance includes 2951 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local SSDs. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512, Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8) for accelerated matrix operations, and cryptographic acceleration via VAES and SHA_NI.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong memory and processing capabilities. Geekbench single-core and image processing performance rank in the top tier (top 10%), while multi-core execution, software compilation with Clang, and ray tracing fall into the strong category (top 25%). Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks via gzip and bzip3 also achieve top-tier status. For database and memory-bound workloads, the server registers strong performance in Passmark database operations, Redis SET operations (88.12 million operations per second), and static web serving throughput. Large-block memory reads and writes, however, perform in the average tier.

The inclusion of Intel AMX instructions enables notable performance in machine learning workloads without dedicated GPUs. LLM inference for text generation using a small 135M model reaches top-tier speeds, while prompt processing and text generation for medium 7B models remain strong. For large 70B models, text generation speed drops to the average tier. Given the combination of high-capacity local NVMe storage, substantial memory-to-core ratio, and strong database benchmarks, this server is well-suited for high-throughput database systems, memory-intensive data processing, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 server configured with 48 vCPUs (24 physical cores) powered by a 2.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor, 372.0 GB of RAM, and 2951 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives. It features advanced CPU instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations. Benchmarks reveal top-tier performance in single-threaded compression, image processing, and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside strong multi-core, database, and Redis execution. The server's 7.75 GB of RAM per core and high-speed local storage deliver qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is highly suited for database hosting, large-scale software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
